주)팜크로스 제조 · 1일 1회 1정

이 제품은 나이아신 10mg, 마그네슘 100mg, 비오틴 50μg, 비타민 B1 50mg, 비타민 B12 80μg, 비타민 B2 50mg, 비타민 B6 50mg, 비타민 D 25μg, 셀레늄 40μg, 아연 30mg, 엽산 400μg, 판토텐산 50mg를 표시량으로 담은 12원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 10mg, 마그네슘 100mg, 비오틴 50μg, 비타민 B1 50mg, 비타민 B12 80μg, 비타민 B2 50mg, 비타민 B6 50mg, 비타민 D 25μg, 셀레늄 40μg, 아연 30mg, 엽산 400μg, 판토텐산 50mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없으며 반점이 있는 밝은 노란 주황색의 장방형 제피정제 · 주)팜크로스 제조

  • 판토텐산

비타비맥시멈Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 주)팜크로스 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 10mg of Niacin, 100mg of Magnesium, 50μg of Biotin, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 80μg of Vitamin B12, 50mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 25μg of Vitamin D, 40μg of Selenium, 30mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 10mg Niacin, 100mg Magnesium, 50μg Biotin, 50mg Vitamin B1, 80μg Vitamin B12, 50mg Vitamin B2, 50mg Vitamin B6, 25μg Vitamin D, 40μg Selenium, 30mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 50mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주)팜크로스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)
